## Your Cloud.  
Your Control.

Deployed inside your own VPC through our unique Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) architecture. Every signal stays private and secure in your environment, with predictable costs and no tradeoffs between visibility and cost.

[BYOC Architecture](/byoc)

## Full-fidelity telemetry. Zero  
instrumentation.

An adaptive eBPF sensor collects and processes telemetry at the edge, with no code changes. It sees across your whole stack, from infrastructure to applications to AI workflows, with native support for OpenTelemetry and open standards.

[eBPF Sensor](/ebpf-sensor)[Open Telemetry](/deep-dive/opentelemetry)

## Engineers and agents. Side by side.

Agent Mode isn't a search bar bolted onto a dashboard. It's an engineer that works alongside your team. Give it a goal and it decides how to get there - which signals to pull, which queries to run, what to build. Teach it your team's conventions with Skills, and it works the way you work, by your rules.

[Agent mode](/product/agent-mode)[MCP](/ai-observability/mcp-server)
